title: Beyond Client Averaging: A Client-Independent Second-Order Stationary-Bias Component in Stochastic SCAFFOLD
abstract: arXiv:2608.26765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing constant-step analysis of stochastic \Scaf{} identifies a leading $O(\gamma/N)$ stationary mean bias and shows that higher-order bias can persist as the client count increases, but does not identify the first client-independent contribution at coefficient level. For full-participation stochastic \Scaf{} with one-dimensional homogeneous clients, fixed local-step count $H$, and bounded additive gradient noise, we prove, uniformly over $N\ge2$,   $$ \begin{aligned} \mathbb{E}_{\pi_{\gamma,N,H}}[x]-x^\star ={}& -\frac{f'''(x^\star)\sigma^2}{4f''(x^\star)^2}\frac{\gamma}{N}\\ &- \frac{f'''(x^\star)\sigma^2}{12f''(x^\star)} \frac{(H-1)(5H-1)}{H}\gamma^2 +O_H\!\left(\frac{\gamma^2}{N}+\gamma^3\right). \end{aligned} $$   Hence client averaging suppresses the leading $O(\gamma/N)$ bias but does not remove the client-independent $O(\gamma^2)$ component when its coefficient is nonzero. translated_title: 超越客户端平均：随机SCAFFOLD中与客户端无关的二阶平稳偏置分量
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26765v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现有对随机SCAFFOLD的常数步长分析识别出一个主导的O(γ/N)平稳均值偏置，并表明随着客户端数量增加，高阶偏置可能持续存在，但未在系数级别识别出第一个与客户端无关的贡献。对于全参与随机SCAFFOLD，在一维同质客户端、固定本地步数H和有界加性梯度噪声的条件下，我们证明，在N≥2上均匀地，有： E_{π_{γ,N,H}}[x]-x^* = - (f'''(x^*)σ²)/(4f''(x^*)²) * (γ/N) - (f'''(x^*)σ²)/(12f''(x^*)) * ((H-1)(5H-1))/H * γ² + O_H(γ²/N + γ³)。因此，客户端平均抑制了主导的O(γ/N)偏置，但当其系数非零时，并不能消除与客户端无关的O(γ²)分量。该机制是间接的：尽管直接贡献被抑制，但间接路径导致该偏置保留。
tldr: 本文证明了随机SCAFFOLD中客户端平均只能消除主导的O(γ/N)偏置，但无法去除与客户端数量无关的O(γ²)二阶偏置分量，并给出了精确系数表达式。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that client averaging in stochastic SCAFFOLD only removes the leading O(γ/N) bias but cannot eliminate the client-independent O(γ²) second-order bias component, with exact coefficient expressions provided.
